# volcano Provider

Interact with the Volcano platform API (projects, databases, functions, frontends, storage, and related configuration).

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    volcano = {
      source = "benjamin-lykins/volcano"
    }
  }
}

# token may also be supplied via the VOLCANO_TOKEN environment variable,
# and endpoint via VOLCANO_API_URL.
provider "volcano" {
  token = var.volcano_token
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `endpoint` (String) Base URL of the Volcano API. Defaults to https://api.volcano.dev. May also be set via the VOLCANO_API_URL environment variable.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Bearer credential used to authenticate to the Volcano API: a platform token (pk-), project access token (pt-), or service key, depending on which resources are used. May also be set via the VOLCANO_TOKEN environment variable.
